purpose: Historical observed pose contract for future coordinated read-only evaluation; no live publisher started

pose.transform_direction: odom_T_camera: maps camera-link coordinates into odom coordinates; camera pose expressed in experiment odom
pose.reference: camera, not Go2 body; no verified camera-body extrinsic
pose.header_stamp: Input timestamp retained with override_publishing_stamp=false requested; ROS epoch driver mapping, raw sensor clock domain NOT_OBSERVED
pose.covariance_verification: NOT_OBSERVED; do not use as measured fusion uncertainty
pose.use: Observe/record/compare only in isolated lab domain; no operational odometry/TF/control feed

slam.semantics: SLAM corrected path separate from continuous VO odometry; potential correction/jumps must be observed, loop correction NOT_RUN here

status.timing: Per-frame track and callback durations; rolling mean/max are not independent per-frame samples; not end-to-end age
status.freshness: Check status and pose update gaps separately; TRACKING is not proof of loop closure or relocalization

tf.readback_scope: Verified in older VO run; requested by followup launch, full followup readback FAILED_CAPTURE
tf.operational_map_odom_base_link: No experiment publish or guessed identity camera-body transform

replay_clock: use_sim_time=true + /clock; sensors and selected original static camera TF only, no recorded estimator output or dynamic TF
